title: Mask pronouns in retrieval keys and neutralize example texts (switch, default on)
description:
## Purpose

Stop pronouns from becoming a label shortcut in shown examples and retrieval keys.

## Scope

Pronoun-masked retrieval keys (always on for bios); pronoun-neutralized example texts with an on/off switch (default on) so F-raw vs F-neutralized can be compared live.

## Definition of done

Specs show masked keys and neutralized examples contain no gendered pronouns; the switch is recorded in the bundle and run manifest. Cost: $0 (live comparison budgeted in the rounds task, about $0.5).
